items.title: The agent builds the app, the user claims the database: how Ideavo does it
items.summary: Ideavo is a free AI app builder where users generate apps from natural language. Instead of charging a subscription, Ideavo has no subscription and no credits - users connect their own API key or AI subscription from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, or another provider, and the Ideavo agent builds with it.
items.creator: Carlota Soto
